name: pantau
description: Pantau — web performance audits with Google Lighthouse and DeepSeek AI (Final Year Project)
author: Muhammad Alif Marzuki bin Rizuan

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "node scripts/wait-for-server.js && npm start --prefix client"
scripts.prod: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm start --prefix server
